name: precision-truck-parts-helpdesk
description: Sistema integral de gestión de tickets de soporte técnico, solicitudes de insumos, control de inventario, acceso a manuales técnicos y seguimiento de incidencias para Precision Truck Parts, Parts and Accesories, S.A de C.V.

scripts.dev:all: chcp 65001 >nul && concurrently -k -n "BACK,FRONT" -c "yellow,cyan" --timestamp --timefmt "HH:mm:ss" "node --import ./server/load-env.js server/server.js" "npm run dev -w client --silent"
scripts.produccion: npm run build && npm run iniciar
scripts.iniciar: chcp 65001 >nul && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=5173 node --import ./server/load-env.js server/server.js
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: eslint server client/src client/tests client/vite.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix server client/src client/tests client/vite.config.js eslint.config.js
